applies_why: The judge text decides that the point involving Matthew 1:20 was answered in [CR3] LINK 2, which is the rule's subject of whether a verse is counted as an unanswered witness.
rule_words: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
room: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted: one reading is that an answered verse is categorically excluded from the unanswered-witness count; the other is that it is excluded only if the judge also quotes the pressing sentence and names the round. I adopt the first because the rule separately states answered verses are not counted.
why: Because the judge says the point was answered in [CR3] LINK 2, K-G4 does not count it as an unanswered witness.
